reason: A more clearly extends prior single-phase HEA findings into a testable dual-phase-coating mechanism by localizing dynamic precipitation at coherent FCC/BCC interfaces and predicting interface-specific microscopy and creep outcomes. Both proposals have a processing confound—quenching or aging may not selectively control precipitation during creep—but B more directly restates the cited dynamic-recrystallization/precipitation result and treats recrystallization as beneficial despite evidence that grain refinement can accelerate creep.
